fieldValues.title: 3. Choose a response: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: Each problem gets a remedy worth trying, and the programme's purpose ranks which remedies run first.

What we have tried: Remedy records with does_not_fix and a falsifier; periods rank objectives and clerk roadmap derives epic priority; story MoSCoW and the board rollup; srs-rust's retired gh-project on Project #5; the frozen v12 strategy roadmap; exercises and plans.

Problems recorded here: SP-97, SP-02, SP-03, SP-04.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 1, Weigh options and commit to one: too far toward Weigh. Affirming the pilot domains appeared in five plans in seven days although it was done on 10-16 (work-flow audit, 2026-10-23).
- Model B: the P0 and P1 epics in semanticops.com idle since 10-07; audit remedies re-planned rather than done.
- The stage's other two tensions stay as records under its domain, out of this map (one trade-off per stage, owner, 2026-10-25).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- The trade-off is untested: its four 2×2 cases are not filled yet.
- Does model B name it better? (B's name for this stage's trade-off is in exercise B4.)
fieldValues.next_action: Fill the 2×2 cases from the stage's own history; then name the remedy that moves us back out of each shadow.
